verdict.rationale: Hightouch's own docs say marketers can build audiences in a no-code UI in Customer Studio, which builds traits and audiences on top of warehouse data, and a community comparison confirms a business-user UI for visual audience filtering. Behavioral events are collected into the warehouse, but nothing shows behavior-based conditions in the builder or an estimated audience size before activation. Missing for 10: any evidence of an audience size estimate or preview before activating, explicit documentation of behavioral/event conditions in the visual builder, and in-depth builder docs or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can build audiences from traits and behavior in a visual builder — no SQL required — and see estimated size before activating

citations.quote: Once the schema is configured, marketers can build audiences and journeys in a no-code UI.
Build audiences, explore segments, and activate data in minutes. The self-serve interface for marketers.
Customer Studio builds traits and audiences on top.
a business-user UI for visual audience filtering
